title: Your Cat Doesn’t Know Prime Day Ends Tonight. You Do
gist: A WIRED affiliate deals roundup for pet tech during Amazon Prime Big Deal Days, covering cameras, feeders, fountains, litter boxes and DNA kits with discounts and reviewer picks. Top picks are the Petkit Purobot Max Pro 2 litter box and Petkit YumShare feeder.

insights.claim: Amazon Prime Day now occurs several times a year, and the Prime Big Deal Days ending that night are framed as the best time to buy expensive automatic litter boxes or pet cameras before prices dip again at Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Recurring sales events fragment demand across the year.

insights.claim: The Petkit Purobot Max Pro 2 is the reviewer's best overall automatic litter box, with an AI camera and app tracking, listed at $442 on Petkit after a 26% discount.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: AI cameras are becoming a standard feature of pet-tech premium tiers.

insights.claim: The Petkit PuraMax 2 is the litter box the reviewer recommends to most people, at its lowest price of the year at $300 on Amazon.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Prior-gen models offer value as new releases arrive.

insights.claim: The Petkit YumShare Dual-Hopper 2 AI-camera feeder is the reviewer's favorite, at $130 on Petkit and Chewy, the lowest price this year.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Petkit leads multiple pet-tech categories in this review.

insights.claim: The Furbo 360 Dog Camera is listed at $54 (71% off from $184) on Furbo, and the Petcube Cam 360 at $33 at Chewy.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Deep discounts on cameras suggest high list-price markups.

insights.claim: The Petkit EverSweet Ultra with AI camera fountain is $211 at 16% off, while the Petlibro Dockstream is at its lowest, 12% cheaper than ever.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Connected health-tracking features are pushed even into fountains.

insights.claim: Embark is described as widely regarded as the most accurate at-home dog DNA test, and the Wisdom Panel cat test is judged useful for health insights but useless for breed insights.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Reviewer view of which genetic data is worth paying for.
insights.quote: Getting breed insights for cats is basically useless
